heading.en: Jesus calls and commissions the twelve disciples—He delivers to the Nephites a discourse similar to the Sermon on the Mount—He speaks the Beatitudes—His teachings transcend and take precedence over the law of Moses—Men are commanded to be perfect even as He and His Father are perfect—Compare Matthew 5. About A.D. 34.
heading.sm: Ua valaauina ma tofia e Iesu soo e toasefululua—Ua ia tuuina atu i tagata sa Nifaē se lauga e pei o le Lauga i le Mauga—Ua Ia fofogaina Faaamuia—Ua sili ma taua atu ana aoaoga nai lo le tulafono a Mose—Ua poloaiina tagata ia atoatoa i latou e pei ona atoatoa o Ia ma Lona Tamā—Faatusatusa i le Mataio 5. E tusa o le 34 T.A.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words unto Nephi, and to those who had been called, (now the number of them who had been called, and received power and authority to baptize, was twelve) and behold, he stretched forth his hand unto the multitude, and cried unto them, saying: Blessed are ye if ye shall give heed unto the words of these twelve whom I have chosen from among you to minister unto you, and to be your servants; and unto them I have given power that they may baptize you with water; and after that ye are baptized with water, behold, I will baptize you with fire and with the Holy Ghost; therefore blessed are ye if ye shall believe in me and be baptized, after that ye have seen me and know that I am.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fetalai mai e Iesu nei upu ia Nifae, ma i latou o e na valaauina, (o lenei o le aofai o i latou o e na valaauina, ma ua maua le mana ma le pule e papatiso atu ai, e toasefululua) ma faauta foi, sa ia faaloaloa mai lona aao i le motu o tagata, ma fofoga mai ia te i latou, ua fetalai mai: Amuia outou pe afai tou te uai atu i upu a lenei toasefululua o e ua ou filifilia mai totonu ia te outou e auauna atu ia te outou, ma avea ma a outou auauna; ma o i latou ua ou tuuina atu i ai le mana ina ia mafai ona latou papatiso ai outou i le vai; ma pe a uma ona outou papatiso i le vai, faauta, o le a ou papatisoina outou i le afi ma le Agaga Paia; o lea amuia lava outou pe afai tou te talitonu mai ia te au ma papatiso, ina ua uma lea ona outou vaai ia te a’u ma iloa o loo i ai a’u.

w.en: And it came to pass that
to the words of these twelve
with fire and the Holy Ghost;

verses.en: And again, more blessed are they who shall believe in your words because that ye shall testify that ye have seen me, and that ye know that I am. Yea, blessed are they who shall believe in your words, and come down into the depths of humility and be baptized, for they shall be visited with fire and with the Holy Ghost, and shall receive a remission of their sins.
verses.sm: Ma ou te toe fai atu, e sili atu ona manuia o i latou o e e talitonu ia outou upu ona o le a outou molimau atu sa outou vaai ia te a’u, ma ua outou iloa o loo i ai a’u. Ioe, amuia i latou o e e talitonu ia outou upu, ma o ifo i le loloto o le lotomaualalo ma papatiso, ona o le a asiasia i latou i le afi ma le Agaga Paia, ma o le a latou maua se faamagaloga o a latou agasala.

w.en: with fire and the Holy Ghost,

verses.en: Yea, blessed are the poor in spirit who come unto me, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: Ioe, amuia e matitiva i le agaga o e e ō mai ia te au, aua e o latou le malo o le lagi.

w.en: blessed are the poor in spirit

verses.en: And again, blessed are all they that mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verses.sm: Ma ou te toe fai atu, amuia i latou uma o e e faanoanoa, aua o le a faamafanafanaina i latou.

verses.en: And blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.sm: Ma amuia e e agamalu, aua o le a fai mo o latou tofi le lalolagi.

w.en: for shall be for their inheritance

verses.en: And blessed are all they who do hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ma amuia i latou uma o e e fia aai ma fia feinu i le amiotonu, aua o le a faatumuina i latou i le Agaga Paia.

w.en: And blessed are all they who

verses.en: And blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.sm: Ma amuia e e alolofa atu, aua e alofaina mai i latou.

w.en: for mercy shall be shown them.

verses.en: And blessed are all the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
verses.sm: Ma amuia i latou uma o e e loto mama, aua o le a latou vaai i le Atua.

w.en: And blessed are all they who

verses.en: And blessed are all the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.sm: Ma amuia i latou uma o e e faatupuina le filemu, aua o le a ta’ua i latou o fanau a le Atua.

w.en: And blessed are all they who

verses.en: And blessed are all they who are persecuted for my name’s sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: Ma amuia i latou uma o e ua sauaina ona o lo’u igoa, aua e o latou le malo o le lagi.

w.en: And blessed are all they who

verses.en: And blessed are ye when men shall revile you and persecute, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake;
verses.sm: Ma amuia outou pe a upu leagaina ma sauaina outou e tagata, ma fai mai ituaiga uma o mea leaga e faasaga ia te outou e tuua’ia pepelo ai outou, ona o a’u;

w.en: when they revile and persecute you
and say all manner of evil

verses.en: For ye shall have great joy and be exceedingly glad, for great shall be your reward in heaven; for so persecuted they the prophets who were before you.
verses.sm: Aua o le a outou maua le olioli tele ma le fiafia naua, aua o le a silisili lo outou taui i le lagi; aua sa faapea ona latou sauaina o perofeta o e na muamua ia te outou.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I give unto you to be the salt of the earth; but if the salt shall lose its savor wherewith shall the earth be salted? The salt shall be thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ou te tuu atu ia te outou ia fai ma masima o le lalolagi; ae afai e magalo le masima o se a se mea a faamai ai le lalolagi? O le a mai i lena taimi ona leai se mea e aoga ai le masima, ae na’o le lafoaiina i fafo ma soli i lalo o vae o tagata.

w.en: to be the salt of the earth;
but only to be cast out
and trodden under the feet of men.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I give unto you to be the light of this people. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hid.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ou te tuu atu ia te outou ia avea outou ma malamalama o lenei nuu. O se aai e faatu i luga o se maupuepue e le mafai ona lilo.

verses.en: Behold, do men light a candle and put it under a bushel? Nay, but on a candlestick, and it giveth light to all that are in the house;
verses.sm: Faauta, pe tutu ea e tagata se lamepa ma tuu i lalo o se pusa teu saito? E leai, ae latou te tuuina i luga o se tuugalamepa, ma o le a susulu atu ai lona malamalama ia i latou uma o e o i totonu o le fale.

verses.en: Therefore let your light so shine before this people, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.sm: O lea ia faasusulu atu ai lo outou malamalama i luma o lenei nuu, ina ia latou vaai ai ia outou galuega lelei ma viia lo outou Tamā o i le lagi.

verses.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law or the prophets. I am not come to destroy but to fulfil;
verses.sm: Aua tou te manatu ua ou sau e faaumatia le tulafono po o perofeta. Ou te lei sau e faaumatia ae e faataunuu;

w.en: I have not come to destroy

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, one jot nor tittle hath not passed away from the law, but in me it hath all been fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ona e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, sa lei mavae atu lava se iota e tasi po o se mataitusi e tasi mai le tulafono, ae ua faataunuuina uma lava ia te a’u.

verses.en: And behold, I have given you the law and the commandments of my Father, that ye shall believe in me, and that ye shall repent of your sins, and come unto me with a broken heart and a contrite spirit. Behold, ye have the command– ments before you, and the law is fulfilled.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua ou tuu atu ia te outou tulafono ma poloaiga a lo’u Tamā, ia outou talitonu mai ia te au, ma ia outou salamo ia outou agasala, ma o mai ia te au ma le loto momomo ma le agaga salamo. Faauta, ua i o outou luma poloaiga, ma ua faataunuuina le tulafono.

w.en: the law and commandments of my Father,

verses.en: Therefore come unto me and be ye saved; for verily I say unto you, that except ye shall keep my commandments, which I have commanded you at this time, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: O lea ia outou o mai ia te au ma faaolaina; ona e moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, vagana ai o le a outou tausia au poloaiga ia ua ou poloaiina ai outou i lenei taimi, e leai lava se ala o le a mafai ona outou ulu atu ai i le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, and it is also written before you, that  thou shalt not kill, and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment of God;
verses.sm: Ua outou faalogo na fai mai i latou o e o taimi anamua, ma ua tusia foi i o outou luma, aua e te fasioti tagata, ma o soo se tasi e fasioti tagata o le a nofo sala i le faamasinoga a le Atua;

w.en: it was said by those who

verses.en: But I say unto you, that whosoever is angry with his brother shall be in danger of his judgment. And whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council; and whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.sm: Ae ou te fai atu ia te outou, soo se tasi e ita i lona uso o le a nofo sala i lana faamasinoga. Ma o soo se tasi e fai atu i lona uso, Raka, o le a nofo sala i le fono; ma o soo se tasi e fai atu, Lou vale, o le a nofo sala i le afi o seoli.

verses.en: Therefore, if ye shall come unto me, or shall desire to come unto me, and rememberest that thy brother hast aught against thee—
verses.sm: O lea, afai tou te o mai ia te au, pe tou te mananao e o mai ia te au, ma e manatua ua i ai i lou uso se mea e faasaga ia te oe—

verses.en: Go thy way unto thy brother, and first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come unto me with full purpose of heart, and I will receive you.
verses.sm: Ia e alu atu i lou ala i lou uso, ma muamua ona e faalelei i lou uso, ma ona e sau ai lea ia te au ma le faamoemoe atoa o le loto, ma o le a ou taliaina oe.

verses.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly while thou art in the way with him, lest at any time he shall get thee, and thou shalt be cast into prison.
verses.sm: Ia vave ona e faalelei ma lou fili a’o e i ai i le ala faatasi ma ia, nei maua oe e ia i se taimi, ma lafo ai oe i le falepuipui.

w.en: while thou art in the way

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, thou shalt by no means come out thence until thou hast paid the uttermost senine. And while ye are in prison can ye pay even one senine? Verily, verily, I say unto you, Nay.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te oe, e leai se auala e tatala mai ai oe i fafo sei vagana ai ua e totogi atu senine uma lava. Ma a’o e i ai i le falepuipui, e mafai ea ona e totogi atu se senine e tasi? E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te oe, E leai.

verses.en: Behold, it is written by them of old time, that thou shalt not commit adultery;
verses.sm: Faauta, ua tusia e i latou o taimi anamua, aua e te mulilua;

w.en: it is written by those of

verses.en: But I say unto you, that whosoever looketh on a woman, to lust after her, hath committed adultery already in his heart.
verses.sm: Ae ou te fai atu ia te outou, soo se tasi e vaai atu i se fafine, e tuinanau ia te ia, ua uma ona mulilua o ia i lona loto.

verses.en: Behold, I give unto you a commandment, that ye suffer none of these things to enter into your heart;
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ia outou le tuu se tasi o ia mea ia ulu i totonu o lou loto;

w.en: that ye let not one of these things

verses.en: For it is better that ye should deny yourselves of these things, wherein ye will take up your cross, than that ye should be cast into hell.
verses.sm: Aua e sili ona lelei ona outou faafiti o outou lava mai nei mea, ia o le a outou ave ai i luga la outou satauro, nai lo le lafoina o outou i seoli.

verses.en: It hath been written, that whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement.
verses.sm: Ua tusia, o soo se tasi na te faate’a i lana ava, ia tuu atu e ia ia te ia se tusi o le teteaga.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery; and whoso shall marry her who is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, soo se tasi na te faate’a i lana ava, vagana ai mo le pogai o le faitaaga, ua ia faamuliluaina o ia; ma o soo se tasi e faaipoipo i le fafine o lē ua faate’aina, ua mulilua.

w.en: he causes her to commit adultery;

verses.en: And again it is written, thou shalt not for– swear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths;
verses.sm: Ma ua tusia foi, aua e te tauto pepelo, a ia fai au tautoga i le Alii;

verses.en: But verily, verily, I say unto you, swear not at all; neither by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
verses.sm: Ae e moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia aua lava nei tauto atu; po o i le lagi, aua o le nofoalii lea o le Atua;

w.en: for it is the throne of God;

verses.en: Nor by the earth, for it is his footstool;
verses.sm: Po o i le lalolagi, aua e mapu i ai ona aao;

verses.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair black or white;
verses.sm: Aua foi nei e tauto atu i lou ulu, aua e le mafai ona e faauliuli pe faapaepae se lauulu e tasi;

w.en: because thou canst not make black

verses.en: But let your communication be Yea, yea; Nay, nay; for whatsoever cometh of more than these is evil.
verses.sm: A ia fai a outou fesootaiga i le na’o le Ioe, ioe; Leai, leai; aua o soo se mea e taua e sili atu nai lo nei, ua leaga.

verses.en: And behold, it is written, an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth;
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ua tusia, o se mata mo se mata, ma se nifo mo se nifo;

w.en: and a tooth for a tooth;

verses.en: But I say unto you, that ye shall not resist evil, but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also;
verses.sm: Ae ou te fai atu ia te outou, aua nei outou faatautee i le leaga, ae ai se na te po mai i lou alafau taumatau, ia liliu atu foi ia te ia le isi;

verses.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also;
verses.sm: Ma afai e i ai se tagata na te molia oe i le tulafono ma ua aveese lou peleue, ia tuu atu foi ia te ia lou pulupulu;

w.en: And if there be a man

verses.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi na te faamalosiina oe e te alu i se maila e tasi, o faatasi ma ia i maila e lua.

verses.en: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not away.
verses.sm: Ia avatu ia te ia o lē e ole mai ia te oe, ma aua e te liliu ese mai ia te ia o lē e manao e nono mai ia te oe.

verses.en: And behold it is written also, that thou shalt love thy neighbor and hate thine enemy;
verses.sm: Ma faauta ua tusia foi, ia e alofa atu i lou tuaoi ae ia inoino i lou fili;

verses.en: But I say unto you, love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them who despitefully use you and persecute you;
verses.sm: Ae faauta ou te fai atu ia te outou, alolofa i o outou fili, faamanuia atu ia i latou o e e fetuu mai ia te outou, fai mea lelei ia i latou o e e inoino mai ia te outou, ma tatalo mo i latou o e latou te faaaoga outou ma le inoino ma sauaina outou;

verses.en: That ye may be the children of your Father who is in heaven; for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good.
verses.sm: Ina ia avea outou ma fanau a lo outou Tamā o lē o i le lagi; ona ua ia faia lona la ia oso ae i luga o le leaga ma luga o le lelei.

verses.en: Therefore those things which were of old time, which were under the law, in me are all fulfilled.
verses.sm: O lea o ia mea o taimi anamua, ia sa i lalo o le tulafono, ua faataunuuina uma ia te au.

verses.en: Old things are done away, and all things have become new.
verses.sm: Ua faate’a atu mea tuai, ma ua faafouina mea uma.

w.en: and all things have become new.

verses.en: Therefore I would that ye should be perfect even as I, or your Father who is in heaven is perfect.
verses.sm: O lea ou te manao ia outou atoatoa e pei lava o a’u, po o lo outou Tamā o lē o i le lagi e atoatoa.

w.en: I would that ye be perfect
